name: gBar
summary: Lightweight status bar for Wayland written in C++ with GTK.
description: A lightweight status bar and widget set written in C++ with GTK 3. It runs on Wayland compositors with layer-shell support and adds a workspaces widget on Hyprland, plus optional NVIDIA GPU and Bluetooth status. Available from the AUR as gbar-git and as a Nix flake with a home-manager module.
